taskVersion.name: ves-real-item

parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station Bank-road (Bori Metropolis). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 640 | 5.21 | 5.21
2 | 934 | 8.58 | 13.8
3 | 2594 | 84.1 | 97.9
4 | 4386 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this sounding curve as AA-type.

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: Bank-road (Bori Metropolis)
Curve type: AA-type
Aquifer depth: 13.8 m – 97.9 m
Recommendation: Target the main aquifer zone identified between 13.8 m and 97.9 m (resistivity ~2594 ohm-m), which likely represents a saturated sand/gravel horizon; drill and screen through this interval while confirming lithology with cuttings, and note the underlying high-resistivity layer (4386 ohm-m) below 97.9 m may represent a deeper, possibly less permeable or bedrock unit worth logging for confirmation.
